title: YxiCraft
description: A light texture pack that gives you better game experience!
body:
## **What is YxiCraft?**

It is a texture pack which gives you better game experience! It has customized block texture, improved GUI, redesigned items, smoother particles, enhanced environment details and loads of other cool stuffs! Perfect for both survival and creative play.
